paragraphs.text: Small, independently installable plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
# dsh-plugins
简体中文 / English
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins by klarkxy. Browse them on the plugin site, which shows install comma
nds and each plugin's documentation.
## Plugins
| Package | What it does |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-current-title` | Auto Title: session titles follow the latest task automatically; na

mes you set by hand stay put. Auto-rename and manual naming coexist. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-git-commit` |
Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping commits and gen

erating commit messages. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-delegation` | Delegation Mode: per-session switch where t
he main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work, enabling multi-agent

orchestration. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-safe-auto` | Safe Auto: adds a Safe Auto approval level where a re
viewer model answers approval requests one call at a time, with full review history and audit trails

. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-session-manager` | Session Manager: search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions ac
ross working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a re
ply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork th

e current session or message other sessions. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-model-hub` | Subagents: configure the
model and reasoning effort for new subagents, and see their last-used model in the conversation pop

up. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-magpie` | Magpie: connect DSH to a Magpie gateway on this computer, your local
network or elsewhere, and sync its models, default model and web search; supports local LLMs and Op

enAI-compatible endpoints. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-web-search-manager` | Web Search: manage and rank searc

h and page-reading services, including providers from installed plugins, in one settings page. |
| `
@klarkxy/dsh-zhihu` | Zhihu: search Zhihu and the web, check hot lists, Zhida AI answers, Q&A;, comm
ents, knowledge bases, creator stats, and quotas, and manage article, question, and pin drafts with

image uploads. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-font` | Font: customize the interface, conversation, code and termi

nal fonts and font sizes of the Web GUI. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-unrestricted` | Unrestricted: a session p
reset that removes the limits on what the model answers and delivers complete results, only in sessi

ons that pick it; may get your account banned. |
| `@klarkxy/dsh-dev-index` | DSH Docs: browse offic
ial DSH developer documentation in the Plugins page; the agent gets two read-only tools to search do
cs and inspect plugins across the catalog, npm, and GitHub (`dsh_docs`, `dsh_plugins`). |
`@klarkxy/dsh-plugin-kit` and `@klarkxy/dsh-model-route` are shared libraries that other plugins ins
n-kit` and `@klarkxy/dsh-model-route` are shared libraries that other plugins install automatically.
